sample.name: Sample
sample.deliverable: Automated one-page field-check report with evidence and suggested repairs; no bespoke manual audit.

lite.name: Lite
lite.deliverable: Selected public-page diagnostics for up to 5 URLs with a combined findings report and prioritized repair list.

comprehensive.name: Comprehensive
comprehensive.deliverable: Selected public-page diagnostics for up to 15 URLs with consolidated findings, repeated-issue grouping and a retest checklist.

shared_limitations: No private accounts, store credentials, feed audit, checkout testing, continuous monitoring, or guaranteed indexing, recommendation, traffic or sales.
Unsupported or non-public URLs are rejected before charging.

crm_destination_policy.private_system_of_record: CommerceLint CRM Google Sheet (out of band)
